Surfaces.Contract: Start a failure-only caller owner before cancellation, expiry validation and connection preflight. Borrow it through tracked acquisition, retries, capacity-error translation and required cleanup before final publication.
Delegate disposal to the permit's internal release owner. An unacquired attempt has no command or error boundary.

Verification, renewal and release start failure-only owners before validation or gate waits and publish once after result disposal, surrender cleanup and gate release. Disposal never publishes caller failures; its bounded release and detached retries own internal observations.

Boundaries.Name: semaphore-acquire
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow acquisition ownership through routing, script retries, conversion and bounded owner-token cleanup. Preserve the mapped caller exception.

Boundaries.Name: semaphore-renew
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow renewal ownership through validation, gate admission, tracked reply and surrender; preserve cancellation status and retry counts.

Boundaries.Name: semaphore-release
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow release ownership through gate admission, reply disposal, required cleanup and gate release.

Boundaries.Name: semaphore-cleanup
Boundaries.Contract: Report failures as handled under the open caller owner. After the bounded foreground wait, use an independent failure-only internal owner so detached cleanup cannot mutate a later caller rental.

Boundaries.Name: semaphore-disposal
Boundaries.Contract: Detached disposal retries have internal lifetimes and never publish a caller-visible final failure.
